## Improvements

- Usage connection problems are confirmed sooner with up to two extra checks about a minute apart after a failed refresh. Providers' requested waiting periods take priority, including when refreshing manually.
- Limit warnings can now appear after a temporary refresh failure when fresh readings confirm a newly crossed threshold in the same usage cycle. Previously delivered and paused alerts are not repeated.

## Fixes

- Every enabled provider now receives automatic usage checks, regardless of the selected tab or whether the window is hidden in the notification area.
- Warnings rejected by Windows can be retried while still relevant, and no longer produce recovery messages for warnings Windows never accepted.
